summary: Static Web Server is a cross-platform, asynchronous utility designed specifically for serving static files over HTTP. Built in Rust, it aims to deliver high performance while handling multiple requests concurrently with low resource overhead.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers who need a lightweight, dedicated binary or container to serve pre-compiled frontend assets, documentation, or static sites.
watchOut: It focuses strictly on static files, meaning you will need separate solutions for dynamic backend processing, database integration, or complex application routing.
deployNotes: Because it typically runs as a standalone container or binary, you will usually need to mount a volume containing your static assets and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
